courses.title: Algorithmic Foundations of Artificial Intelligence
searches: "CSCI 3202" Colorado Boulder "Fall 2025" OR "Spring 2026" OR "Spring 2025" syllabus Algorithmic Foundations of Artificial Intelligence
"CSCI 3202" "generative AI" OR ChatGPT OR "AI policy" Colorado Boulder
courses.note: Elective: the major requires five courses from an approved Computer Science Core list that includes CSCI 3202; no AI or ML course is required. CSCI 3202 is the department's introduction to AI. The only public syllabus is an old instructor page (text refers to the Russell and Norvig 2nd edition) with no term stated and no AI-tool policy, so it is undated-only; the department says current syllabi must be requested from the instructor.

"CSCI 2400" Computer Systems Colorado Boulder "Fall 2025" OR "Spring 2026" syllabus "generative AI" OR ChatGPT
courses.note: Required (the major lists CSCI 2400 Computer Systems in the core; CSCI 3753 Operating Systems is only an elective option). The newest public syllabus found is Fall 2019, before ChatGPT, so it is outdated; no AI text.

notes: CU Boulder has no single required AI syllabus statement; faculty set their own policy under academic freedom (CTL guidance). The department says undergraduate syllabi are not posted and must be requested from the instructor, so C1 and C2 are not-found.
